_about: How the voices of Episode 2 v2 were made, so that new or changed lines can be voiced in the same session. Audio files are never in the repository; paths are on the voice machine ($HI_VOICE_WORK=/opt/work/voice).
engine: the local voice pipeline (/opt/vx, float32 config copy), CPU, voxgen.gen(cfg=2.0, steps=10), 48 kHz

TAGAPAGSALAYSAY.reference: $HI_VOICE_WORK/cast/TAGAPAGSALAYSAY.wav + .txt (the Episode 1 v2 narrator, cast kit 4; md5 0a3af8641c6cb979d535881da4817233)
TAGAPAGSALAYSAY.how: gen_ms.py: continuation from the reference clip padded to 0.80 s of silence (refs/TAGAPAGSALAYSAY_t80.wav) with its exact transcript, the same clip as timbre reference; no tone prompt (tone tags do not steer designed voices)
TAGAPAGSALAYSAY.chunks: ms.py plan: runs of up to 3 sentences / 170 characters in one turn; a chunk is re-voiced whole
TAGAPAGSALAYSAY.seed_policy: seeds 1, 2, 3 per chunk (more only where no take passes); the take is chosen by sel.py: words right, then every sentence's pace (syllables / aligned speech time of that sentence) inside 5.0-5.5 syl/s or nearest to it, then fewest failed checks
TAGAPAGSALAYSAY.level: each line levelled (BS.1770 K-weighted, gated) to within 0.25 LU of his median line loudness, before the master (ep2 assembly)

INDIO.reference: the user's own Episode 1 recording (HI_VOICE_REC), gen.py mode U: tone prompt cut from the real recording + timbre reference
INDIO.rule: speaker similarity to the real-recording centroid >= 0.93; asides and whispers in the same clone (tone tag only)

USMAN.reference: $HI_VOICE_WORK/cast/USMAN.wav (Episode 1 v2 Usman, cast kit 1; md5 fda0e493e538c3a150ca4758f6e89754)

SEPA.reference: $HI_VOICE_WORK/cast/SEPA.wav, designed: cast_design.json SEPA description 0, seed 2 (castwork/SEPA/d0s2); md5 97bcb7df3e7f5c39a552bb84e126ee59

GUWARDIYA.reference: $HI_VOICE_WORK/cast/GUWARDIYA.wav = GUWARDIYA_EP2.wav, designed: cast_design.json GUWARDIYA_EP2 description 1, seed 2 (castwork/GUWARDIYA_EP2/d1s2); md5 df06017104378d1e8fdefe7e5cb0a09e

say_overrides: English words whose respelling the voice misread are spoken as English, which carries the same stress: 'delivery rider' (s7), 'rider' (s14), 'app' (s13, s109, s111), 'order' (s111); 'galing kay em' (s116). Re-apply after a new script if sentences.json is regenerated.
gaps: speech to speech 0.30-0.45 s inside a scene (about 0.36 in a turn, 0.40 between turns), about 0.80 s at a scene change
master: -17.4 LUFS integrated, true peak under -1.2 dBFS; Indio's lines get the match EQ to the real recording
